observation: The first four-service development run reached healthy services and teardown, but the emitted packet was rejected because the service manifest preserved startup order while the offline verifier requires canonical service order.
affected_invariant: A service evidence packet must have one canonical service manifest representation so an independent verifier can compare it without process-order assumptions.
correction: Canonicalized the service list as [minio, nats, postgres, zitadel] before emitting results, packet, and verifier expectations.
regression_assertion: The service packet verifier accepts only the canonical sorted service list and every future packet must emit that same list in all service-manifest locations.
